outputs.explanation: Panel A top shows a bar chart of mean±s.d. cell death (%) across conditions, but no individual data points (from the three independent experiments) are overlaid on the bars.
Panel B top shows a bar chart of cell death (%) across conditions; only bars (with error bars in some) are shown, with no individual data points plotted.
Panel C is a grouped bar chart of mean±s.d. cell death (%) at multiple time points across three conditions and two genotypes; individual replicate values are not shown, only bars with error bars.
Panel D top shows a bar chart of cell death (%) with error bars for various transfection conditions, but individual data points behind these averages are not displayed.
